note: Member 5 research register for the five initial investigations plus one research synthesis. Shaped like the contract Investigation object plus a 'member5' block. This is NOT curated data: Member 3 owns data/curated/investigations.json and the manifest. measured_records_imported is 0 for every entry. No test-level NASA measurements have been imported. 'dataset_doi' is the investigation-level NASA PSI dataset DOI, checked against the DataCite registry; it is not the DOI of the quoted source. Investigation tags (relevant_environments) hold only environments the investigation's own sources state (Member 5 decision 2026-11-14, accepting Member 3's proposal in PR #6 docs/verification/environment_tag_mapping.md; gate E2). Wider Moon/Mars applicability belongs in Member 5 interpretation findings with limitations.
